items.zh: 支持从 Pinner 打开指定卡片的评论管理器，固定编辑目标，并保护未完成操作、取消与迟到请求。
items.en: Open Comment Manager for a specific card from Pinner, keeping the editing target fixed and guarding unfinished operations, cancellations, and late requests.

items.zh: 原生摘录新增下移入口；移动前确认卡片转换和链接迁移，支持取消、不再提示及设置恢复。
items.en: Native excerpts gain a move-down action. Confirm card conversion and link migration before moving, with cancellation, an option to skip future prompts, and a setting to restore prompts.

items.zh: 浮动按钮与 Pinner、Literature 采用统一避让规则，覆盖迟到控件、触摸期间位置保持、无空间隐藏和停用清理。
items.en: Floating controls share placement priorities with Pinner and Literature, handling delayed controls, touch holds, hiding when space is unavailable, and cleanup on unload.

items.zh: 修复文本及图片摘录首次移动的转换和排序；位置不变时不转换卡片。
items.en: Fix conversion and ordering on the first move of text and image excerpts. No-op moves do not convert the card.

items.zh: 改善 Catalyst 下拉选项的触摸选择、滑动取消、短暂失焦和 Escape 焦点恢复。
items.en: Improve Catalyst dropdown touch selection, scroll cancellation, transient blur handling, and focus restoration after Escape.

items.zh: 单卡菜单依据可用空间调整方向和宽度，普通文本筛选和统计排除链接及摘要评论。
items.en: Single-card menus adapt their direction and width to available space. Plain-text filtering and counts exclude link and summary comments.

items.zh: 摘录转换、链接迁移、撤销与重做、Pinner 定向编辑及各设备浮动按钮和触摸操作仍待真实设备验收。
items.en: Excerpt conversion, link migration, undo and redo, Pinner-targeted editing, floating controls, and touch interactions still require device acceptance.

items.zh: 内置处理操作纳入可编辑的默认工作流，支持修改名称和步骤、复制与出厂模板恢复；单选和多选分别配置菜单位置及手动顺序。
items.en: Built-in operations are editable default workflows with customizable names and steps, copying, and factory-template restoration. Single-card and multi-card menus have independent placement and manual ordering.

items.zh: 旧工作流配置迁移前备份，保存后回读校验；菜单顺序不再随使用次数变化，隐藏位置保留以便恢复。
items.en: Legacy workflow configurations are backed up before migration and verified after saving. Usage counts no longer change menu ordering, and hidden positions are retained for restoration.

items.zh: 工作流编辑优先展示名称、步骤和菜单位置，高级筛选及管理操作按需展开；复制、恢复、未保存草稿提示及焦点处理更一致。
items.en: The workflow editor prioritizes names, steps, and menu placement, with advanced filters and management controls expanded on demand. Copying, restoration, unsaved-draft prompts, and focus handling are more consistent.

items.zh: 快速输入跟随所属窗口的软键盘收起通知下移并淡出，参数不可用时采用短淡出；保留草稿和Markdown模式，并防止旋转、失焦及旧通知误关新窗口。
items.en: Quick input follows keyboard dismissal in its owning window with a downward fade, falling back to a short fade when animation data is unavailable. Drafts and Markdown mode are retained, with guards against rotation, focus loss, and stale notifications closing a new window.

items.zh: 快速输入的原生覆盖区域与网页共同避开MN5顶部胶囊，主面板默认、恢复及最大化布局同步避让；修复小窗口尺寸溢出和低高度按钮不可达。
items.en: The native quick-input overlay and its web content avoid the MN5 top capsule. Default, restored, and maximized main-panel layouts also avoid it. Small-window overflow and unreachable controls in short viewports are fixed.

items.zh: 关闭前等待中文组词结束，异常时保留正文；修复关闭失败时正文回退、保存开始时提前关闭和迟到回调干扰新输入的问题。
items.en: Closing waits for Chinese IME composition to finish and retains the text on errors. Failed closes no longer revert newer text, saving does not close input prematurely, and late callbacks cannot affect a new input session.

items.zh: 仅含筛选条件的工作流不能作为执行流程保存；菜单可直接打开管理页，页面加载、关闭重开和其他编辑窗口结束后的请求正确清理与恢复。
items.en: Filter-only workflows cannot be saved as executable workflows. Menu entries open the manager directly, with proper request cleanup and recovery during page loading, reopening, and after other editors close.

items.zh: MN5快速输入显示已获初步确认；iPad和iPhone键盘动画、中文输入及完整多窗口仍待设备验收，兼容胶囊定位不代表正式保护边界已经验证。
items.en: MN5 quick-input visibility has preliminary user confirmation. iPad and iPhone keyboard animations, IME input, and full multi-window behavior still require device acceptance; compatibility capsule lookup does not establish the exact host protection boundary.

items.zh: 浮动入口新增添加评论图标，独立输入窗口支持回车提交、Shift＋回车换行、纯文本粘贴及中文输入法选词。正文追加到打开输入窗口时的目标卡片末尾。
items.en: A new floating add-comment icon opens a lightweight input window with Enter to submit, Shift+Enter for a new line, plain-text paste, and IME-safe input. New comments append to the note selected when the window opens.

items.zh: 输入窗口支持原生 Text 与 Markdown 评论类型切换，并通过插件配置记住最近选择；未提交草稿保留在当前窗口会话中，新输入不关联已有评论。
items.en: The input window switches between native Text and Markdown comments and remembers the last choice in addon preferences. Unsubmitted drafts remain in the current window session, independently of existing comments.

items.zh: 管理与添加按钮的单击、长按动作支持分别配置为打开管理器、添加评论、打开处理菜单或不执行操作；添加按钮可以单独隐藏。
items.en: Manage and add buttons offer separate tap and long-press actions for opening the manager, adding a comment, opening the processing menu, or doing nothing. The add button can be hidden separately.

items.zh: 输入窗口采用圆角、柔和阴影和深浅主题，入场同步淡入；保存确认后，面板缩小并移向目标卡片，周围遮罩与原生覆盖层提前渐隐。减少动态效果时使用短淡入淡出。
items.en: The input window uses rounded corners, soft shadows, light and dark themes, and synchronized entry fades. After confirmed saving, the panel shrinks toward the target note while the backdrop and native overlay fade early. Reduced motion uses short fades.

items.zh: 动作标签保持完整显示，双按钮整组避让卡片、原生菜单及其他浮动控件，减少标签拆行和入口遮挡。
items.en: Action labels stay on one line, and the floating button group avoids notes, native menus, and other floating controls to reduce awkward wrapping and obscured entry points.

items.zh: 相同提交标识只追加一次，保存后回读核对正文和评论类型；保存结果不明确时保留原提交并提供核对入口，保存失败时保留正文。
items.en: Each submission ID appends at most once, with saved text and comment type verified by readback. Uncertain results retain the original submission and provide reconciliation, while failed saves preserve the text.

items.zh: 修复 Markdown 开启后提交回执类型不一致的问题，会话与提交记录保留在 JavaScript 闭包中，避免原生动态属性转换影响校验。
items.en: Fixed inconsistent receipt types after enabling Markdown. Sessions and submission records remain in JavaScript closures to prevent native dynamic-property conversions from affecting validation.

items.zh: 修复快速提交时透明度重置、关闭回执丢失后窗口卡住，以及旧窗口回调干扰重新打开的问题；乱序草稿请求不能覆盖较新的正文。
items.en: Fixed opacity resets on fast submission, stuck windows after lost close acknowledgements, and old callbacks interfering with reopened input. Out-of-order draft requests cannot overwrite newer text.

items.zh: 支持按 HTML、Markdown、HtmlMD、嵌套标题及指定文本划分评论模块，提供全局默认和单卡片覆盖，设置由插件层保存并回读确认。
items.en: Comment modules support HTML, Markdown, HtmlMD, nested headings, and specified text rules. Global defaults and per-card overrides are persisted and verified by the addon.

items.zh: 支持模块定位、内容显隐、整组选择、同级移动、正文移动和提取为子卡片；整组选择可配置是否包含结构标题，并包含筛选隐藏成员。模块全选后可批量折叠或展开评论。
items.en: Modules support navigation, visibility, group selection, sibling reordering, body moves, and extraction to child notes. Group selection optionally includes structural headings and includes filtered members. Fully selected modules expose bulk comment folding controls.

items.zh: 支持正文链接和评论窄间隙起点，容忍轻微斜向启动及同向移动时的自然间距变化；拖动回缩依据初始选区恢复，单指保留原生滚动。
items.en: Two-finger range selection can start on body links and narrow comment gaps, tolerates slightly diagonal starts and natural finger spacing changes during a pan, restores the initial selection on backtracking, and preserves native one-finger scrolling.

items.zh: 缓存评论位置和渲染结果，按动画帧合并移动事件，仅更新变化的选区；边缘滚动速度渐进变化，抬手处理最后一帧，列表中部静止时停止连续计算。
items.en: Long lists reuse comment geometry and rendered content, coalesce movement per animation frame, and update only changed selections. Edge scrolling accelerates progressively, release flushes the final frame, and stationary gestures away from edges stop continuous processing.

items.zh: 下拉框统一采用面板样式的 HTML 控件，支持键盘选择、关闭及焦点恢复；移动端压缩工具栏和按钮布局，底栏避让原生缩放手柄。
items.en: Dropdowns use HTML controls matching the panel, with keyboard selection, dismissal, and focus return. Compact mobile toolbars and buttons reserve footer space for the native resize handle.

items.zh: 修复未使用标识的过严校验导致 macOS 和 iPad 折叠入口消失及错误提示的问题，继续核验必需状态、版本和保存回执；操作失败时重新读取状态并提供具体错误信息。
items.en: Fixed excessive validation of unused identifiers that disabled folding and displayed errors on macOS and iPad. Required state, revisions, and persistence receipts remain validated; failed operations trigger a readback and detailed diagnostics.

items.zh: 修复选择折叠或展开动作后直接保存遗漏动作的问题；空动作和保存回读异常会明确提示，保存失败时保留草稿。
items.en: Fixed fold or unfold actions being omitted when saving immediately after selection. Empty actions and failed persistence readbacks produce explicit errors, and failed saves retain the draft.

items.zh: 修复 Markdown 触摸节点在选区更新后断开、手势中断及外部操作被旧选区覆盖的问题；模块设置未收到一致保存回执时保留草稿并提示错误。
items.en: Fixed Markdown touch targets disconnecting on selection updates, gesture interruption handling, and stale gesture selections overwriting external actions. Module settings retain the draft and report an error when a consistent persistence receipt is missing.

items.zh: 在提供批注折叠接口的宿主中，评论管理器支持读取和修改每条批注的折叠状态。左侧按钮支持展开或折叠，折叠后保留两行摘要、图片缩略图和状态标签，搜索仍匹配完整内容。
items.en: On hosts exposing comment folding APIs, the manager reads and changes each comment's fold state. Left-side disclosure buttons toggle previews; folded comments retain two-line summaries, image thumbnails, and state labels, while search still matches the full content.

items.zh: 所选批注支持批量展开或折叠，多卡片编辑器和工作流新增对应动作。成功后保留选区，筛选隐藏项仍参与处理，原生摘录不参与折叠；每张卡片每次最多处理 200 条批注。
items.en: Selected comments can be folded or unfolded in bulk, with matching actions in the multi-card editor and workflows. Successful writes preserve selection, including hidden selected comments, and exclude native excerpts. Each host call handles up to 200 comments per card.

items.zh: 多选时点击已选批注的左侧按钮，整个选区统一采用该条批注切换后的状态；未选批注仍单独处理。按钮提供操作范围提示并支持键盘操作。
items.en: Clicking a selected comment's disclosure applies its toggled state to the entire selection. Unselected comments are toggled individually. Tooltips and accessible names describe the affected selection, with keyboard support.

items.zh: 原顶栏继续提供选择和全局操作，底栏固定显示选区状态与批量折叠按钮。移动、转换、合并和删除等操作集中在“更多选区操作”面板，正文独立滚动。
items.en: The existing header retains selection and global commands. A fixed bottom bar shows selection state and folding controls, while move, convert, merge, and delete actions are available in More selection actions. Comments scroll independently.

items.zh: 折叠操作由宿主管理保存、读回校验和撤销。工作流分别管理宿主折叠操作与其余连续步骤的撤销；版本冲突或保存失败时重新读取状态并提示错误。
items.en: The host manages folding persistence, readback verification, and undo. Workflows keep host folding transactions separate from undo groups for other consecutive steps. Revision conflicts and failed saves trigger a state readback and an error message.

items.zh: 短窗口压缩固定栏布局并保留可滚动的顶部操作入口。切换批注后保持点击项头部可见，避免操作栏挤压正文或遮挡按钮。
items.en: Short windows use compact fixed bars and a scrollable header action row. Disclosure toggles keep the clicked comment header visible, preventing controls from squeezing the reading area or obscuring buttons.

items.zh: “更多选区操作”面板支持 Esc 关闭和焦点返回。进入插入位置选择时关闭菜单，编辑窗口关闭后返回可见控件。
items.en: More selection actions supports Escape dismissal and focus return. Entering insertion mode closes the menu, and closing an editor returns focus to a visible control.

items.zh: 新增“显示图片摘录文本”设置，默认关闭；开启后立即显示图片下方原文并保存设置，隐藏不删除原文，也不影响复制和普通文本摘录。
items.en: Added a persistent “Show image excerpt text” setting, off by default. Enabling it immediately shows the text below an image; hiding it preserves the source text, copying, and regular text excerpts.

items.zh: 工作流动作参数支持按类型配置、默认值及恢复默认，并在保存、预览和执行前校验参数。
items.en: Workflow action parameters now have typed controls, defaults, and reset options, with validation before saving, previewing, and execution.

items.zh: 工作流保存失败或回执未确认时保留草稿，切换或关闭未保存内容前提示，并改善步骤焦点和对话框中文输入交互。
items.en: Workflow drafts are retained when saving fails or the receipt is unconfirmed. Unsaved changes prompt before switching or closing, with improved step focus and Chinese input handling in dialogs.

items.zh: HTML 转换保留可表达的富文本结构并提示无法安全转换的内容；替换评论前核验写入结果，减少原内容丢失风险。
items.en: HTML conversion preserves supported rich text structures and reports content that cannot be converted safely. Replacement writes are verified before removing the original comment to reduce the risk of content loss.

items.zh: 工作流选择器的「评论类型」从单选升级为多选，可同时匹配文本 / Markdown / HTML 等多种类型，并提供「全部评论」「所有文本」快捷按钮。
items.en: The workflow selector's "comment type" filter now supports multi-select, matching multiple types such as text / Markdown / HTML at once, with quick "all comments" and "all text" shortcuts.

items.zh: 失效链接清理增加实时扫描进度反馈，显示已找到和无法确认的链接数量，不再是清理完才知道结果；插件的批量处理按钮现在会自动避让 MarginNote Pinner 面板的跟随模式扩展按钮。
items.en: Invalid link cleanup now shows live scan progress with counts of found and unresolved links instead of only after completion; the batch action button now automatically avoids MarginNote Pinner's follow-mode extra button.

items.zh: 设置项保存后会回读确认并在失败时提示具体原因；搜索框支持一键清空；桥接通信增加超时保护，避免请求无响应卡死。
items.en: Settings now verify via readback after saving and show the specific reason on failure; the search box supports one-tap clearing; bridge commands now have timeout protection to avoid unresponsive hangs.

items.zh: 修复批量工作流在多选卡片变化后误用旧选区、部分合并失败时误报成功、工作流配置损坏时静默清空、单卡工作流执行前选区状态错乱等问题。
items.en: Fixed batch workflows using a stale selection after the multi-select set changed, some merge failures being misreported as success, workflow config being silently wiped when corrupted, and selection state issues before running a single-card workflow.

items.zh: 单卡菜单新增「工作流」子菜单，可直接在单张卡片上执行保存的工作流，无需进入多选模式；支持范围设置（单卡/多卡/两者），菜单会按范围筛选。
items.en: Single-card menu now includes a "Workflows" submenu to run saved workflows directly on one card without multi-select mode; supports scope settings (single/batch/both) with menu filtering by scope.

items.zh: 选择器新增位置过滤功能，支持单个索引（如 0 第一条、-1 最后一条）或范围（如 0 到 -1），可精准选择特定位置的评论；保存前自动验证有效性，批量编辑器支持预览匹配结果。
items.en: Selectors now support position filtering with single index (e.g., 0 for first, -1 for last) or range (e.g., 0 to -1), allowing precise targeting of comments at specific positions; validation before save, batch editor shows preview of matches per card.

items.zh: 所有内置动作（HTML 转换、评论合并/删除/反转、转为非摘录版）的支持范围从「仅多卡」扩展为「单卡/多卡」，可在单卡工作流中使用。
items.en: All built-in actions (HTML conversion, comment merge/delete/reverse, convert to no-excerpt) now support both single and batch modes, enabling use in single-card workflows.

items.zh: 新增「合并到摘录」功能，可将多条评论直接合并到卡片摘录；图片摘录会自动转为文本摘录并保留原图；支持设置为默认行为。
items.en: Added "merge to excerpt" feature to combine multiple comments into the card excerpt; image excerpts automatically convert to text excerpts while keeping the original image; can be set as default behavior.

items.zh: 新增评论工作流系统，支持保存和复用批量评论处理流程（选择评论 → 编辑 → 合并/删除等），可在批量菜单和单卡菜单中快速调用。
items.en: Added comment workflow system to save and reuse batch comment processing flows (select comments → edit → merge/delete etc.), accessible from both batch and single-card menus.

items.zh: 新增失效链接清理功能，可分别清理失效的卡片链接、Markdown 行内链接或全部清理，操作前预览影响范围，可撤销。
items.en: Added invalid link cleanup to remove broken card links, Markdown inline links, or both; shows preview of affected cards before execution, and is undoable.

items.zh: 批量处理按钮支持长按（0.45 秒）打开扩展菜单，未来可用于快速访问保存的工作流。
items.en: Batch action button now supports long-press (0.45s) to open an extended menu, for future quick access to saved workflows.

items.zh: 合并摘录中的 Markdown 正文现在会被识别为独立的「合并 Markdown」类型，可正常渲染、编辑和参与链接迁移。
items.en: Markdown text inside a merged excerpt is now recognized as its own "merged Markdown" type, and renders, edits, and follows link migration correctly.

items.zh: 修复移动、删除、批量清空、转为非摘录版等操作后卡片不会立即刷新，需手动拖拽才能看到变化的问题；转为非摘录版生成的子卡片现在会保留原文档定位。
items.en: Fixed cards not refreshing immediately after move, delete, bulk clear, or convert-to-plain operations (a manual drag was needed); the blank card created by convert-to-plain now keeps the original document location.

items.zh: 修复 Markdown 评论编辑后需要拖拽卡片才能刷新的问题，保存后立即重绘卡片。
items.en: Fixed Markdown comments requiring a card drag to refresh after editing; the card now redraws immediately after saving.

items.zh: 手写评论转换未完成时，列表会显示明确的转换中状态并自动重试刷新，转换完成后自动更新，不再误显示为加载失败或空白占位。
items.en: While a handwriting comment is still converting, the list now shows a clear in-progress status and automatically retries until it refreshes, instead of showing a false failure or blank placeholder.

items.zh: 手写评论现在会在列表中直接渲染预览图，无需打开原生界面即可看到笔画内容。
items.en: Handwriting comments now render a preview image directly in the list, without needing to open the native view to see the strokes.

items.zh: 链接评论新增「更新链接」按钮，可用剪贴板中的卡片链接直接替换目标，并自动迁移反向链接。
items.en: Added an "Update link" button on link comments that replaces the target using the clipboard's MarginNote card link and migrates any reverse link automatically.

items.zh: Markdown 评论正文中的卡片链接现在可以直接点击定位，无需先转成链接评论。
items.en: MarginNote card links inside Markdown comment text can now be tapped directly to locate the card, without converting them into a link comment first.

items.zh: 面板新增原生摘录显示与操作：可选择卡片摘录并对其执行移动、删除、合并、提取为子卡片、复制等操作；涉及摘录的操作会自动完成「转为非摘录模式」转换。
items.en: The panel now shows the card's native excerpt, which can be selected and used in move, delete, merge, extract-to-child, and copy operations; operations involving the excerpt automatically perform a no-excerpt conversion first.

items.zh: 新增「转为非摘录模式」操作，批量多选菜单和单卡操作菜单均支持，将有摘录的卡片转换为纯评论卡片。
items.en: Added a "Convert to comment-only" action available in both the batch menu and the single-card action menu, converting excerpt cards into comment-only cards while preserving all content.

items.zh: Markdown 评论现支持格式化渲染预览，含数学公式（KaTeX）；单卡弹出菜单时显示「评」浮动按钮，点按打开评论面板，长按打开单选处理菜单；面板新增「设置」可控制两个操作按钮的开关。
items.en: Markdown comments now render with formatting preview including math formulas (KaTeX); a floating 「评」 button appears on single-card popups — tap to open the panel, long-press for a single-card action menu; a new Settings page controls both action buttons.

items.zh: 移除内置的 MNUtils/MNNote 副本，改为明确依赖已安装并启用的 MN Utils；缺失依赖时停用插件并给出提示。
items.en: Removed bundled MNUtils/MNNote copies and made the installed MN Utils runtime an explicit dependency; the addon now disables itself with a clear message when the dependency is unavailable.

items.zh: 新增构建与回归门禁，防止源码和安装包重新携带 vendored MNUtils/MNNote。
items.en: Added build and regression guards that prevent vendored MNUtils/MNNote files from returning to source or release packages.

items.zh: 新增批量「去掉所有链接」操作：一次性移除多选卡片中的纯卡片链接评论，操作前提示受影响卡片数和链接条数。
items.en: Added a batch "Remove all links" action: removes plain link comments from multiple selected cards at once, with a preview of affected cards and link count before confirming.

items.zh: 优化运行时依赖隔离，避免与其他已加载 MNUtils 的插件重复注册产生冲突；修复区域检测在遇到反爬虫响应时误报连接错误的问题。
items.en: Improved runtime dependency isolation to avoid conflicts with other add-ons that already load MNUtils; fixed a false connection-error report when region detection hits an anti-bot response.

items.zh: 修复扩展卡片弹出菜单屏蔽：在 blank/blankHighlight 类型的扩展卡片上触发弹出菜单时，不再错误地同步面板显示。
items.en: Fixed popup menu on extend notes: panel sync is no longer triggered when the popup menu appears on blank/blankHighlight type extend notes.

items.zh: 图片评论类型精细化：PaintNote 现在能准确区分纯图片、纯手写、图片+手写三种情况，便于后续针对不同类型做差异化处理。
items.en: Refined image comment types: PaintNote now accurately distinguishes between pure image, pure drawing, and image+drawing, enabling differentiated handling in the future.

items.zh: 提取子卡片标题优化：移除「提取自 xxx」的默认标题预填充，改为空字符串，让用户根据实际内容自行命名。
items.en: Extract child card title optimization: removed the default 'Extracted from xxx' pre-filled title, now using an empty string to let users name cards based on actual content.

items.zh: 修复面板位置存储兼容性：保存时序列化为 JSON 字符串，读取时兼容处理字符串和对象两种格式，避免升级后面板位置丢失或异常。
items.en: Fixed panel position storage compatibility: serializes to JSON string on save and handles both string and object formats on load, preventing panel position loss or abnormalities after upgrades.

items.zh: 行内合并对话框：链接材料现在分层显示为「标题 + 链接」两行结构，优先使用卡片标题，避免在材料列表中看到大段重复的 URL。
items.en: Inline merge dialog: link materials now display as a two-line structure (title + URL), prioritizing card title to avoid repetitive long URLs in the material list.

items.zh: 提取评论对话框增强：标题输入框旁新增「清空标题」按钮，快速清空预填充文本。
items.en: Enhanced extract dialog: added 'Clear Title' button next to the title input for quickly clearing pre-filled text.

items.zh: 卡片标题设置容错：setNoteTitle 函数增强，尝试多个属性路径提升跨版本兼容性。
items.en: Improved note title setting: setNoteTitle function now tries multiple property paths for better cross-version compatibility.

items.zh: 优化触摸交互：删除/移动按钮的长按事件处理改用统一的 suppressPressDefaults / releasePressCapture 模式，防止长按触发文字选择、拖拽和右键菜单。
items.en: Optimized touch interaction: delete/move button long-press handlers now use unified suppressPressDefaults / releasePressCapture pattern, preventing text selection, drag, and context menu during long press.

items.zh: 提取评论为子卡片时，自动将其他卡片中指向原卡片的链接（LinkNote 评论和 Markdown 行内链接）迁移为指向新子卡片，避免提取后出现失效链接。
items.en: When extracting comments to a child card, links in other cards pointing to the source card (LinkNote comments and Markdown inline links) are automatically migrated to the new child card, preventing broken links after extraction.

items.zh: 新增 UndoGroupingHelper 模块，所有评论操作均通过带名称的 undo 分组执行，回退历史更清晰。
items.en: Added UndoGroupingHelper module so all comment mutations run inside named undo groups for clearer undo history.

items.zh: PopupMenuOnNote 观察者改为随评论面板开/关动态注册，面板未打开时不再响应卡片弹窗事件。
items.en: PopupMenuOnNote observer is now registered only while the comment panel is open, preventing unintended sync triggers when the panel is closed.

items.zh: 优化数据库刷新防抖：连续的 refreshAfterDBChanged 请求合并为 trailing debounce，嵌套 undoGrouping 只由最外层触发刷新，减少制卡链路中的重复 DB refresh。
items.en: Optimized DB refresh: consecutive refreshAfterDBChanged calls are merged via trailing debounce, and nested undoGrouping now only triggers a refresh from the outermost call.

items.zh: 新增 HTML 评论转 Markdown 功能：单卡评论列表可将选中的 HTML 评论一键转为纯文本 Markdown；批量菜单同步支持多卡片批量转换。
items.en: Added HTML-to-Markdown conversion: selected HTML comments on a card can be converted to plain Markdown in one tap; also available as a batch action across multiple cards.

items.zh: 新增 stable-only 在线更新清单，上传安装包到 123 网盘直链目录后可生成 MNUtils 插件商店可读取的 manifest。
items.en: Added a stable-only online update manifest so MNUtils can read the latest package after it is uploaded to a 123pan direct-link directory.

items.zh: 新增结构化双语更新日志 JSON，方便 MNUtils 在历史版本页展示各版本更新内容。
items.en: Added structured bilingual changelog JSON so MNUtils can show version notes in the history page.

items.zh: 批量菜单新增清空所有评论和清空所有标题操作，支持多卡片确认与撤销分组。
items.en: Added batch actions to clear all comments or all titles across selected cards, with confirmation and undo grouping.

items.zh: Markdown 行内链接定位支持与卡片链接一致的点按/长按行为，并修复长按触发文字选择的问题。
items.en: Markdown inline link locating now supports the same tap and long-press behavior as card links, with text selection suppressed during long press.

items.zh: 新增 Markdown 行内链接列表与编辑弹窗，支持直接修改显示文本和链接地址。
items.en: Added Markdown inline link listing and editing, including separate display-text and URL fields.

items.zh: 快速导航条提升为顶部常驻横向导航，批量选择入口迁入顶栏。
items.en: Promoted quick navigation to a persistent top rail and moved batch selection into the top bar.

items.zh: 新增多选卡片批量评论处理入口，支持只保留第一条内容和提取子卡片后删除原评论。
items.en: Added native multi-card batch comment actions, including keep-first-content and remove-original extraction.

items.zh: 首个正式包：支持查看、筛选、移动、删除、编辑和合并当前卡片评论。
items.en: Initial stable package for viewing, filtering, moving, deleting, editing, and merging comments on the current card.
